task: Bake hardcoded qaData literal in modules/dashboard.html to JSON
summary: Extracted the hardcoded qaData literal (round, date, errors, frameworks) from modules/dashboard.html into dist/modules/trade-qa-card.json via pipelines/build_trade_qa_card.py. The dashboard now fetches the JSON and falls back to the inlined qaDataLiteral on any fetch failure. Tests in tests/test_trade_qa_card.py verify the builder emits a valid JSON file with all four keys and that the fallback wiring in dashboard.html swallows fetch errors so a 404 cannot blank the card.

tests_written: BuilderEmitsValidJsonTest (builder runs clean, valid JSON, all four keys, round=1/date=2026-09-30, non-empty errors/frameworks)
DashboardFallbackContractTest (fallback block in allowed region, fetch call, try/catch swallows errors, qaData falls back to literal, summary uses qaData.round/qaData.date)

notes: Builder extracts the CURRENT hardcoded values from dashboard.html; no new findings invented.
Builder drops the literal's target key and only emits the four keys the brief lists (round, date, errors, frameworks).
Dashboard merges the fetched JSON over the literal via Object.assign so literal-only keys (target) survive.
Builder source range is narrow (1458-1642) so other workers' edits elsewhere in the file do not get parsed.
Fetch failure paths documented in tests because no headless JS harness is wired in this repo.
